mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.user_id, u.nickname AS author_name, u.avatar AS author_avatar, s.title, s.cover_image, s.content, s.summary, s.destination, s.days, s.budget, s.season, s.images, s.tags, s.view_count, s.like_count, s.favorite_count, s.comment_count, s.is_ai_generated, s.audit_status, s.audit_reason, s.status, s.visibility, s.create_time, CASE WHEN l.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_liked, CASE WHEN f.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_favorited FROM strategy s LEFT JOIN user u ON s.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN favorite l ON s.id = l.item_id AND l.item_type = 'strategy_like' AND l.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN favorite f ON s.id = f.item_id AND f.item_type = 'strategy' AND f.user_id = #{userId} WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.deleted = 0

SELECT s.id, s.user_id, u.nickname AS author_name, u.avatar AS author_avatar, s.title, s.cover_image, s.destination, s.days, s.budget, s.tags, s.view_count, s.like_count, s.favorite_count, s.comment_count, s.is_ai_generated, s.audit_status, s.audit_reason, s.root_strategy_id, s.status, s.visibility, s.create_time FROM strategy s LEFT JOIN user u ON s.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(root_strategy_id, id) AS group_id, MAX(id) AS latest_id, MIN(create_time) AS first_create_time FROM strategy WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 GROUP BY COALESCE(root_strategy_id, id) ) latest ON s.id = latest.latest_id WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.status = 1
AND s.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
AND s.audit_status = #{auditStatus}
AND s.destination LIKE CONCAT('%', #{destination}, '%')
ORDER BY latest.first_create_time DESC, latest.group_id DESC

SELECT s.id, s.user_id, u.nickname AS author_name, s.title, s.cover_image, s.destination, s.days, s.budget, s.tags, s.view_count, s.like_count, s.favorite_count, s.comment_count, s.is_ai_generated, s.audit_status, s.audit_reason, s.root_strategy_id, s.status, s.visibility, s.create_time FROM strategy s LEFT JOIN user u ON s.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(root_strategy_id, id) AS group_id, MAX(id) AS latest_id FROM strategy WHERE deleted = 0 AND user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY COALESCE(root_strategy_id, id) ) latest ON s.id = latest.latest_id WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.create_time DESC

SELECT s.id, s.user_id, u.nickname AS author_name, s.title, s.cover_image, s.summary, s.destination, s.days, s.budget, s.tags, s.audit_status, s.audit_reason, s.root_strategy_id, s.status, s.create_time, s.update_time FROM strategy s LEFT JOIN user u ON s.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(root_strategy_id, id) AS group_id, MAX(id) AS latest_id FROM strategy WHERE deleted = 0 AND user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY COALESCE(root_strategy_id, id) ) latest ON s.id = latest.latest_id WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.status = 0 AND s.audit_status != 0 ORDER BY s.update_time DESC
